strings.lang.searchHint: Gbea ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkɔ, Eŋlisigbe ŋkɔ alo kɔdiki

strings.about.disclaimer: Esia nye habɔbɔ aɖe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ. Menye Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ o, eye Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo medoa alɔe o.
strings.overlay.title: Tia gbe aɖe
strings.overlay.subtitle: Xexea ƒo nu le gbe 7,000 kple edzivɔ me. Ele be woase gbewo katã.
